skill.name: Ansible
skill.description: Avoid common Ansible mistakes — YAML syntax traps, variable precedence, idempotence failures, and handler gotchas.
skill.summary: YAML Syntax Traps - Jinja2 in value needs quotes — `"{{ variable }}"` not `{{ variable }}` - `:` in string needs quotes — `msg: "Note: this works"` not `msg: Note: this` - Boolean strings: `yes`, `no`, `true`, `false` pa
